name: Talonpause
description: Square the shoulders and hold both clawed hands before the chest so the blades cover the lines to the face and ribs.

name: Nailhit
description: Reach the clawed hand forward and draw it straight back through the target so the tips drag across skin or cloth.

name: Solid Fingerblade
description: Roll the wrist outward so the back of the hand and the claw base sweep an incoming punch away from the body.

name: Clawbase Pace
description: Slide the lead foot half a pace and bring the rear foot after it to close the gap while the claws stay raised.

name: Knucklespike Wedge
description: Hook the claw tips into the opponent's sleeve or belt and hold the snag to pull his balance off line.

name: Straight Clawtip
description: Drop the clawed hand from shoulder height in a steep arc and rake the tips down the target from top to bottom.

name: Razedash
description: Swing the claw up from the hip under the guard and scoop the tips into the opponent's belly or chin.

name: Raking Shred
description: Bring the rear claw across the chest in a flat slash that crosses the opponent's centerline at rib height.

name: Pawlblow
description: Whip the back of the clawed hand outward from the chest and flick the tips across the opponent's cheek.

name: Pawlcowl
description: Tuck the elbows in and hold the claws beside the temples so a hook punch lands on bone and not the head.

name: Backward Clawrake
description: Step back as the claw drags across the opponent's forearm so the scoring cut and the retreat finish together.

name: Kept Tinecurve
description: Fold the fingers inside the claw guard and raise the forearm to take a kick on muscle while the blades stay clear.

name: Hooding Palmstrap
description: Sweep the outer edge of the claw across the front to knock aside a straight punch before it arrives.

name: Pulling Wristband
description: Turn the palm inward and hook the tips over the incoming wrist to catch it and stop the strike.

name: Holding Talon
description: Hold both claws up in a frame before the face so the blades rake any hand that reaches through it.

name: Tripping Raze
description: Press the flat of the claw base against the chest of a rushing opponent to stop his advance before cutting.

name: Snug Hookclaw
description: Drop both claws low and sweep a low kick off its line with the backs of the blades.

name: Single Scour
description: Pluck the tips across the knuckles of the hand just parried so the counter lands before he can withdraw it.

name: Stepping Rip
description: Glide forward on the balls of the feet with the claws raised so the gap closes before the opponent can set.

name: Backplate Trot
description: Pivot on the lead foot to the outside of a punch so the claws point at the opponent's open flank.

name: Backward Flay
description: Shuffle both feet forward in small steps while the claws stay raised so the guard never opens.

name: Nimble Hookclaw
description: Take one long step straight back and settle the stance so the claws face the opponent again.

name: Backward Talon
description: Drag the rear heel in a small circle to walk around a stronger opponent and keep both claws pointed at him.

name: Single Wristband
description: Drop the hips and step sideways while raking the claw across the opponent's thigh as it passes.

name: Fixing Rip
description: Plant the lead foot hard and hook the claws into the advancing opponent's forearm to halt him.

name: Stepping Raze
description: Step into the gap between the opponent's feet with the claws forward so his kick has no room to land.

name: Locking Knucklespike
description: Sink the tips into the sleeve and haul it across the body so the opponent leans onto the front foot.

name: Towing Tinecurve
description: Snag the claw tips in the belt and drag down so the opponent's hips are pulled forward and low.

name: Scourlid
description: Loop the claw over the wrist and yank hard downward to break the grip of a hand reaching for the neck.

name: Shredblow
description: Hook the tips behind the collar and rake down through the cloth so the opponent's head is pulled forward.

name: Locking Flay
description: Set the tines in the crook of the elbow and drag the arm straight so the opponent cannot bend it to guard.

name: Shredhusk
description: Catch the claw tips in a gripping hand and peel the fingers off the wrist with a short outward twist.

name: Kept Clawtip
description: Draw a slow breath and raise the clawed forearms so qi fills them and the guard stands firm against a blow.

name: Clawrake Drop
description: Rake the claw straight down the target's guard arm with qi in the tips so the cut scores deep into cloth and skin.

name: Leaden Shred
description: Drive the claw tips into the soft gap under the ribs on the exhale so the qi pushes the points deeper.

name: Talonstay
description: Hold the breath and turn the claw back against a hook punch so the qi in the blade knocks it wide.

name: Talontrot
description: Draw breath and slide the rear foot back a pace so the opponent's reach falls short by a finger.

name: Scourhit
description: Rake with the right claw then the left in one rolling breath so each stroke follows the last without a pause.

name: Fingerblade Stay
description: Set the tines on the opponent's wrist with a steady breath and hold the grab as the qi keeps the hook tight.

name: Nailbump
description: Lift the claw above the head and let it fall in a steep line that rakes the target from brow to chest.

name: Nailhusk
description: Raise both claws crossed above the head so a downward strike meets the blade backs and slides off.

name: Backplate Drop
description: Drop the claw point first onto the joint of the shoulder and dig the tips in beside the collarbone.

name: Talonhit
description: Finish the downward rake with a short back step so the guard is set again before the answer comes.

name: Resting Hookclaw
description: Cross the wrists at chest height and catch a driving punch in the fork between the two blades.

name: Nailgauge
description: Press the strap against the wrist bone between exchanges to feel whether the claw sits true before the next stroke.

name: Razewedge
description: Turn the wrist inward and hook the tips around the opponent's arm to draw it across his own body.

name: Angled Knucklespike
description: Lift the hooked tips under an incoming wrist and flip it upward so the strike passes over the shoulder.

name: Pawldash
description: Scoop the claw up from below the waist with a loose wrist and score the inside of the opponent's thigh.

name: Nailblow
description: Throw the wrist outward so the hooked tips snap across the cheek or ear from the side.

name: Nabbing Clawbase
description: Roll the wrist inside an opponent's grip and let the claw tips cut the grabbing fingers loose.

name: Catching Clawtip
description: Press the hooked claw on top of the opponent's forearm and bear down so the arm cannot rise to strike.

name: Ready Palmstrap
description: Lock the strapped forearm against the body so the claw base takes a hard blow without the wrist bending.

name: Raised Clawbase
description: Sink the hips over wide feet and hold the claws forward so the stance resists a shove and keeps the reach.

name: Narrow Scour
description: Push off the rear leg and turn the hips so the rake arrives with the weight of the whole body behind it.

name: Towing Rip
description: Sink the weight and pull the hooked tines down the opponent's arm so his balance follows the pull.

name: Fingerblade Pause
description: Keep the feet planted and turn only the hips to sweep a punch aside with the outer blade.

name: Gnawing Backplate
description: Drop onto the front knee and slash the claws across the opponent's shin as his kick passes overhead.

name: Easing Raze
description: Rise from the crouch in one push of the legs with the claws forward and slip past the opponent's reach.

name: Flat Scour
description: Slash flat across the opponent's chest at arm's length with the clawed hand and pull the hand back to guard.

name: Settled Tinecurve
description: Bring the slashing hand back along the same line so the blade backs catch a counter aimed at the ribs.

name: Razehit
description: Slash with both claws in a crossing X at close range so the opponent cannot cover both lines at once.

name: Ripdrop
description: Hook the claw over the opponent's shoulder line and cut back toward the neck as he turns to guard.

name: Easing Clawrake
description: Duck under a returning slash and step forward so the opponent's arm passes over the back of the neck.

name: Hitching Shred
description: Finish the slash by hooking the tips behind the shoulder blade and drawing the opponent into a close clinch.

name: Planted Wristband
description: Recover both claws to the frame before the chest the instant a slash ends so the front stays closed.
